HCVT's Technology & Transformation practice is seeking an MBA intern to support strategic technology and business transformation engagements for middle-market and private equity-backed clients.

This internship provides an opportunity for MBA students with meaningful professional experience to apply their skills in a consulting environment while gaining hands-on exposure to technology strategy, business process improvement, and digital transformation.

Working alongside experienced consultants, the intern will help assess business challenges, evaluate potential solutions, and develop recommendations that support client transformation initiatives. Engagements may include technology strategy, ERP implementation, data and analytics, AI and automation, process improvement, and change management.

We welcome MBA students with backgrounds in technology, transformation, management consulting, or related fields, as well as professionals seeking to transition into consulting who bring relevant transferable experience.

You will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

  • Support technology and business transformation engagements by analyzing client operations, business processes, and technology environments to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Participate in client interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions to understand business needs, challenges, and objectives.
  • Conduct research and analysis to evaluate potential solutions and support the development of recommendations.
  • Assist in developing technology strategies, business cases, transformation roadmaps, and implementation plans.
  • Support ERP evaluations, system selection, and technology implementation activities, including requirements gathering, solution evaluation, and process design.
  • Research and assess opportunities for AI, automation, data analytics, and process optimization.
  • Prepare client presentations, reports, and other deliverables that communicate findings, insights, and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with engagement teams to support project execution, monitor progress, and address project challenges.
  • Contribute to internal practice development initiatives, including research, methodologies, and proposal development.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities to strengthen consulting, analytical, and technical skills.

To be successful, these are the skills, qualities and experience you will need:

  • Previous experience in technology, transformation, management consulting, or a related business function.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional initiatives, technology implementations, or business process improvement projects.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, data analytics, AI, or automation initiatives.
  • Experience conducting business analysis, developing recommendations, or presenting findings to stakeholders.
  • Relevant transferable experience and a demonstrated interest in transitioning into consulting.

8ccbc1ad4a04.title: T-Maintenance Technician Mechanical - Welding- Journey or Apprentice
8ccbc1ad4a04.title_raw: T-Maintenance Technician Mechanical - Welding- Journey or Apprentice
8ccbc1ad4a04.description_html:
Bring YOUR energy to Alliant Energy!
 

At Alliant Energy, our purpose is to serve customers and build stronger communities.  We are passionate about powering beyond the market challenges of today, while powering what's next in energy.  When our employees say "I am energy", it means they take pride in the work we do when disaster strikes, as well as all the days in between.  We want you to be safe, happy and healthy.  That's why we prioritize safety, offer volunteer opportunities and provide competitive pay, comprehensive health and retirement benefits, tuition reimbursement and paid time off.

This role may be filled at the Apprentice or Journey level dependent upon qualifications.

Residency Requirements:

Travel time from your primary residence to your assigned headquarters must be 60 minutes or less under normal driving conditions.

Job Summary

This is a traveling role that involves regular travel throughout the state of Wisconsin to support and learn about various generation plants, including coal, gas, combustion turbine, solar, wind, and battery generation facilities.

Performs varied mechanical, basic electrical and basic control and instrument maintenance activities and other duties necessary to maintain the generation facility to which they are assigned.
What you will do
  • Performs the mechanical and basic electrical and basic instrument and control troubleshooting, maintaining, repairing, cleaning, inspecting and constructing of equipment and systems for the generation facility.
  • Operates and/or obtains information from various mechanical and electrical devices used to support specific equipment diagnostics or work activities; gathers, interprets and logs data.
  • Is proficient in the use of machine tools and various hand powered tools as job needs dictate.
  • Operates mobile and heavy equipment to perform maintenance tasks.
  • Performs various welding activities.
  • Supports safety, plant reliability, productivity, and plant efficiency improvements by participating in various continuous improvement activities.
  • Performs all work according to established procedures and safety practices.
  • Performs various generating plant and shop area housekeeping functions.
  • Performs other duties which are similar, related, or incidental to this position.

Education Requirements
  • High School Diploma or GED

Required Experience
  • Journey level in the mechanical trade
 

Other Requirements

  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Employees in this job classification are covered by the Residency Policy and will be required to live within 60 minutes of one of the following locations: Columbia, Edgewater, Riverside or Madison.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to solve problems.
  • Well developed skills in machining.
  • Knowledge of theory and skill in welding.
  • Knowledge of company safety rules.
  • High degree of mechanical and/or electrical aptitude.
  • Strong leadership ability.
  • Ability to perform the physical requirements of the job.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Our people are passionate about what they do, the product they sell, and the customers they serve. If you're looking for an opportunity to be a part of a work family that values collaboration, innovation and dedication, we're the right company for you.

Pay Range:

$43.85 - $56.22

Alliant Energy offers a comprehensive total rewards package including competitive compensation and benefit programs. Information on these benefit programs is available on our Careers site.

It's not just what we do; it's how we do it.

Live Safety. Everyone. Always | Make Things Better | Care For Others | Do The Right Thing | Act For Tomorrow | Think Beyond. Be Bold

All candidates selected for employment with Alliant Energy will be required to successfully complete a background check, and a drug screen where applicable.
